errata.correct:
crc[1].status.       present if and only if

errata.notes: This is under Initialization Response. It should be crc[1].status.status to correspond to the crc[1] on the left. This error is inherited from RFC 4210 (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4210#appendix-D.4).

errata.orig:
In such
a case, the senderKID field MUST hold an identifier (i.e., a
reference number) that indicates to the receiver the appropriate
shared secret information to use to verify the message.
errata.correct:
If the sender does not know its own DN and
it protects the message using a shared secret,
the senderKID field MUST hold an identifier (i.e., a
reference number) that indicates to the receiver the appropriate
shared secret information to use to verify the message.
errata.notes:
The above extension allows for the following case:
If the sender does not know its own DN
and does not protect the message, providing a senderKID is not relevant.

errata.correct:
